VALUATION_METHODS._AdditionalDescription: CLARIFICATION OF INTENDED USER AND INTENDED USE: THE ONLY INTENDED USER OF THIS APPRAISAL REPORT IS HOMEXPRESS MORTGAGE CORP. THE ONLY INTENDED USE IS TO EVALUATE THE PROPERTY THAT IS THE SUBJECT OF THIS APPRAISAL REPORT FOR A MORTGAGE FINANCE TRANSACTION, SUBJECT TO THE STATED SCOPE OF WORK, PURPOSE OF THE APPRAISAL, REPORTING REQUIREMENTS OF THIS APPRAISAL REPORT FORM, AND DEFINITION OF MARKET VALUE - THERE ARE NO ADDITIONAL INTENDED USES OR USERS. REPORT RECIPIENTS NOT IDENTIFIED AS INTENDED USERS DO NOT HAVE ACCESS TO THE REPORT'S AGREED UPON 'WORK SCOPE' (THE REPORT RULES & GUIDELINES AS AGREED TO BETWEEN THE APPRAISER AND THE LENDER - CLIENT / USER; AMC), AND MAY NOT BE ABLE TO FULLY UNDERSTAND THE REPORT, OR BE AWARE OF WORK SCOPE REQUIREMENTS THE APPRAISAL MUST ADHERE TO. READERS SHOULD BE AWARE THAT THE APPRAISAL PROCESS INCLUDES SUBSTANTIAL INPUT BY GOVERNMENT AGENCIES, THE LENDER / CLIENT AND THE ORDERING ENTITY (APPRAISAL MANAGEMENT COMPANY) WHICH CAN HAVE A SIGNIFICANT IMPACT ON THE APPRAISAL REPORT'S 'WORK SCOPE' WHICH CAN RESULT IN A SIGNIFICANT IMPACT ON THE VALUE CONCLUSION. =================================================================================== HIGHEST AND BEST USE: I CONSIDERED THE HIGHEST AND BEST USE OF THE SUBJECT PROPERTY AS IF VACANT AND AS IMPROVED. BASED UPON A REVIEW OF THE FOUR CRITERIA (LEGALLY PERMISSIBLE, PHYSICAL POSSIBLE, FINANCIALLY FEASIBLE AND MAXIMALLY PRODUCTIVE) FOR HIGHEST AND BEST USE, THE AS IF VACANT USE WOULD BE FOR A RESIDENCE IN COMPLIANCE WITH CURRENT ZONING CODES. NEXT, I CONSIDERED THE HIGHEST AND BEST USE OF THE PROPERTY AS IMPROVED. BASED UPON A REVIEW OF THE FOUR CRITERIA (LEGALLY PERMISSIBLE, PHYSICAL POSSIBLE, FINANCIALLY FEASIBLE AND MAXIMALLY PRODUCTIVE), THE HIGHEST AND BEST USE OF THE PROPERTY AS IMPROVED WOULD BE AS A SINGLE FAMILY RESIDENCE. ================================== REPORT COMMENTS: MARKET GRID ADJUSTMENTS ARE BASED ON REVIEW OF THE MLS DATA (I READ THE AGENT COMMENTS AND REVIEW THE PROVIDED PHOTOS), REVIEW OF THE MARKET DATA, REVIEW OF PRIOR APPRAISALS FROM THE MARKET AREA AND PAIRING AND CONTRASTING (PAIRED SALES ANALYSIS) THE COMPARABLE DATA, INCLUDING SALE PRICE/PSF INDICATORS. PAIRING CONSIDERATION INCLUDES BOTH GRIDDED DATA AND MARKET DATA REVIEWED WHILE RESEARCHING THIS FILE. IN DEVELOPING THE PRICE/PSF ADJUSTMENTS THE APPRAISAL CONSIDERS THE PURCHASE PRICES OF THE COMPARABLES LESS THEIR ESTIMATED SITE VALUES AND THEN THE ESTIMATED CONTRIBUTION OF THE DEPRECIATED IMPROVEMENTS. ADDITIONAL MARKET RESEARCH RETAINED IN THE REPORT'S WORK FILE. MULTIPLE METRICS ARE REVIEWED IN ORDER TO ENABLE THE APPRAISER TO PROVIDE AN INFORMED OPINION AS TO CURRENT MARKET TRENDS, INCLUDING QUARTER OVER QUARTER DATA FOR BOTH THE OVERALL AND SUB MARKET FOR THE PRIOR 4 - 6 QUARTERS. MARKET GRID ADJUSTMENTS ARE ROUNDED TO THE NEAREST $500.00. SPECIAL MARKET CONDITIONS/PANDEMIC - COVID-19: OFFICIAL DECLARED PANDEMIC DATE IS 03/11/2020. IT SHOULD BE UNDERSTOOD BY THE CLIENT / REPORT READER THAT AS OF THE DATE OF VALUE OF THIS REPORT THE 79+ MONTH DATED W.H.O. CORONAVIRUS / COVID -19 GLOBAL PANDEMIC'S IMPACT HAS BEEN ONGOING DUE TO CONCERNS ABOUT CURRENT / UPCOMING VIRUS VARIANTS. THESE CONCERNS ABOUT THE PANDEMIC / VARIANTS HAVE WANED IN THE LAST YEAR(S), AND RESTRICTIONS HAVE BEEN DIALED BACK OR ELIMINATED ACROSS MUCH OF THE COUNTRY. IN ADDITION TO AFFECTING POPULATION HEALTH ECONOMIC EFFECTS OF THE PANDEMIC(S) HAVE BEEN SEEN ON A LOCAL, NATIONAL, AND GLOBAL LEVEL. A CONFLUENCE OF FACTORS, INCLUDING GOVERNMENT STIMULUS DUE TO THE PANDEMIC HAD RESULTED IN THE FINANCIAL MARKET INDICES, INCLUDING THE STOCK MARKET'S DOW JONES, BREACHING PRIOR RECORD HIGHS; ALONG WITH PRIOR VERY LOW MORTGAGE RATES HAD RESULTED IN HYPERBOLIC PRICE INCREASES / A VERY STRONG REAL ESTATE MARKET. I ASSUME FINANCIAL / MORTGAGE MARKETS WILL CONTINUE TO FUNCTION IN A COMPETITIVE, EFFICIENT FASHION AND CANNOT BE HELD RESPONSIBLE / UNFORESEEABLE EVENTS THAT ALTER FUTURE MARKET CONDITIONS. REPORTEDLY THE BUILDER SUPPLY CHAIN HAD BEEN DISRUPTED BY THE PANDEMIC CAUSING SOME NEW CONSTRUCTION TO BE SLOWED, FURTHER REDUCING AVAILABLE INVENTORY, AND INCREASING BUILDER COSTS. THE DOW JONES / STOCK MARKET HAD INCREASED FROM ITS PRIOR RECORD COVID ERA HIGHS OF ~ 37,000 TO MORE RECENT NEW HIGHS NEAR 54,750 AND IS CURRENTLY @ 51,966, MORTGAGE INTEREST RATES HAVE INCREASED FROM A LOW OF ~ 2.5% ~ 6 YEARS AGO TO 7.45% TO 7.75% CURRENTLY (FOR CONVENTIONAL & JUMBO LOANS RESPECTIVELY) - CONSIDERING HOME PRICES HAVE GENERALLY REMAINED ELEVATED THIS HAS SEVERELY IMPACTED HOUSING AFFORDABILITY. ADDITIONALLY, RUSSIA INVADED THE COUNTRY OF UKRAINE ON 2/24/2022, AND ISRAEL, IRAN-HAMAS-HEZBOLLAH-YEMENI HOUTHIS HAVE BEEN AT WAR OFF AND ON SINCE 10/07/2023 RESULTING IN INCREASED VOLATILITY IN THE COMMODITY, FINANCIAL AND WORLD MARKETS. SUPPLY CHAIN ISSUES NO LONGER MAKE ANY HEADLINES. NOTE: MILITARY ACTION BY THE UNITED STATES AND ISRAEL AGAINST THE COUNTRY OF IRAN ON 01/28/2026 HAS CAUSED TURMOIL IN THE MARKET, A TEMPORARY DECLINE IN 'THE DOW', AND INCREASED INTEREST RATES AND COMMODITY (OIL) PRICES. SHOULD THE IRAN WAR WIDEN , PUT MORE PRESSURE ON THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ, OR TAKE OTHER ACTIONS UPSETTING THE REGION, THE INSTABILITY MAY CAUSE RATES TO RISE FURTHER. ALTHOUGH THE NUMBER OF SELLERS IN MOST MARKETS NOW OUTWEIGH THE NUMBER OF BUYERS MANY ARE STILL HELD BACK BY THE LACK OF AFFORDABILITY IN THE HOUSING MARKET. THE FULL IMPACT OF THE FALLOUT OF THE 2023 COLLAPSE OF SILICON VALLEY BANK & OTHER SMALLER REGIONAL BANKS IS NOT YET KNOWN THOUGH THESE ISSUES NO LONGER ARE MAKING HEADLINES; INFLATION IS STILL SOMEWHAT PERSISTENT IN THE LOCAL MARKET, THE UNITED STATES, AND GLOBALLY BUT HAS GREATLY DECLINED FROM ITS HEIGHTS. THE FEDERAL RESERVE DROPPED THE PRIME RATE 50 BASIS POINTS IN 10/24, 25 BASIS POINTS IN 11/24 & IN 12/24; THERE WERE (3) 25 BASIS POINTS IN 2025. THE 10 YEAR TREASURY NOTE YIELD IS CURRENTLY 5.144%. INFLATION HAS REMAINED STICKY, INTEREST RATES HAVE INCREASED & COULD INCREASE FURTHER (.25 BASIS INCREASE IN THE PRIME RATE AT THE LAST MEETING), WHICH WOULD NEGATIVELY IMPACT RESIDENTIAL HOUSING. THE TYPICAL IMPACT OF ANY FLARE-UP / CONTINUING HOSTILITIES BETWEEN THE US / ISRAEL / IRAN / IRAN PROXIES HAS BEEN INCREASES IN INTEREST RATES, OIL / GASOLINE PRICES, AND OVERALL INFLATION.

SALES_COMPARISON._Comment: THE REPORT COMPARABLES ARE VERIFIED AT MINIMUM BY (1) PUBLIC (COUNTY TAX ASSESSOR), AND (1) PRIMARY (ARMLS AND / OR AGENT PHONE INTERVIEW) DATA SOURCE. THE COMPARABLE REVIEW BEGINS WITH A SEARCH FOR SAME SUBDIVISION / MODEL MATCH' DATA. IF NEEDED THE SEARCH IS EXPANDED TO CONSIDER DATA W/IN ~ 20% IN TERMS OF SIZE, 0 - 12 MONTHS IN TERMS OF SALE DATE, AND THEN FURTHER REFINED TO THE FEATURES / CHARACTERISTICS THAT BEST REFLECT THE SUBJECT'S APPEAL, VALUE AND MARKETABILITY. THESE COMPARABLES ARE THE FRUIT OF THE DESCRIBED SEARCH AND ARE AMONG THE MOST RECENT, SIMILAR AND RELIABLE INDICATORS OF THE SUBJECT'S CURRENT MARKET VALUE. IN ADDITION TO THE PROVIDED DATA, WEIGHT IS GIVEN TO THE ADDITIONAL DATA REVIEWED / CONSIDERED DURING THE APPRAISERS RESEARCH & PREPARATION FOR THIS ASSIGNMENT. GLA ADJUSTED @ $55/PSF; SITE ADJUSTMENTS CALCULATED AT $1/PSF FOR VARIANCES OF 2500 SF OR GREATER. THE OTHER ADJUSTMENTS ARE SELF-EXPLANATORY. SEE ATTACHED FOR COMP #4. IN THE FINAL RECONCILIATION TO VALUE MORE WEIGHT TO THE UPPER-END PRICE RANGE CONSIDERING THE SUBJECT'S UPGRADES, SLAB STONE KITCHEN TOPS / ISLAND, SLAB STONE BATH VANITY TOPS, RECENTLY REMODELED BATH. C#1 IS BEST FOR LOCATION, COMPS #2 & #3 FOR BRACKETING UPGRADES.

_RECONCILIATION._SummaryComment: THE SALES COMPARISON APPROACH BEST REFLECTS THE ACTIONS OF BUYERS & SELLERS IN THE CURRENT MARKET. THE COST APPROACH RELIES ON ESTIMATES OF SITE VALUE, BUILDING COSTS, AND DEPRECIATION FROM ALL CAUSES, SO REDUCING RELIABILITY THAT IT IS NOT DEVELOPED. AN INCOME APPROACH COULD BE DEVELOPED, AND IS BEING USED BY SOME MARKET PARTICIPANTS, BUT IT IS NOT AS RELIABLE AS THE "SCA" NOR NEEDED IN THIS CASE IN ORDER TO PROVIDE A CREDIBLE / SUPPORTED OPINION OF MARKET VALUE.
